Metadata.title: Arewa Is Building
Metadata.description: Gano manhajojin da aka gina a Arewacin Najeriya da wadanda 'yan Arewa suka gina a ko'ina.

Home.eyebrow: Kundin kayan fasaha na Arewacin Najeriya
Home.intro: Kundin bayanai mai tsari don kayayyakin dijital masu amfani, masu ginawa da ra'ayoyi daga Arewacin Najeriya da 'yan diaspora.
Home.searchPlaceholder: Bincika manhaja, rukuni, jiha ko madadi…
Home.latestIntro: Kayayyakin amfani masu tushe a Arewa. Kowanne bayani na jama'a ya wuce bitar masu gyara.
Home.browseByIntro: Fara da jiha ko rukunin kaya.
Home.whyIntro: Arewa na cike da mutane masu warware matsaloli. Wannan wuri ne don sauƙaƙa samun aikinsu.
Home.whyOneText: Nuna kayayyaki daga Kano zuwa Makurdi ga mutanen da ke buƙatarsu.
Home.whyTwoText: Gano hanyoyi masu amfani da suka dace da yanayi, harshe da bukatunmu.
Home.whyThreeText: Muna tantance abubuwan da aka turo don kundin ya ci gaba da amfani da inganci.
Home.whyFourText: Masu ginawa 'yan Arewa a ko'ina suna da wuri a nan.
Home.ctaTitle: Kana gina wani abu mai amfani?
Home.ctaText: Faɗa mana game da shi. Muna duba kowanne bayani kafin ya shiga kundin.

Directory.title: Kundin manhajoji
Directory.intro: Manhajoji, ayyuka da gwaje-gwajen da masu alaƙa da Arewa suka gina.
Directory.searchPlaceholder: Bincika manhajoji, jihohi, rukuni ko madadi
Directory.filtersDescription: Zaɓi abin da ya fi dacewa da kai.
Directory.noResults: Ba a sami abin da ya dace ba.
Directory.noResultsText: Gwada share wata tacewa ko bincika da kalma mafi faɗi.

Product.seedNote: Wannan misalin farko ne yayin da kundin ke girma. Ana duba bayanai kafin wallafawa.

Submit.title: Sanya aikinka a taswira.
Submit.intro: Faɗa mana game da manhajar da aka gina a Arewa ko ta wani ɗan Arewa. Za a duba ta kafin a wallafa.
Submit.signInText: Asusu kyauta zai ba ka damar tura manhaja da bin matsayin bitarta.
Submit.name: Sunan manhaja
Submit.alternativesHint: Raba sunaye da wakafi, misali: Trello, Notion
Submit.tagsHint: Raba alamu har biyar da wakafi
Submit.uploadHint: PNG, JPG ko WebP, girman kowane bai wuce MB 5 ba.
Submit.successText: Mun gode da ka tura {name}. Za mu aiko maka da imel idan an samu sabuntawa.

Auth.title: Barka da zuwa Arewa Is Building
Auth.intro: Shiga domin tura manhaja da sarrafa matsayin bitarta.
Auth.configError: Ba a saita shiga ba tukuna. Sanya bayanan Supabase a .env.local don kunna shiga.
Auth.privacyNote: Asusunka yana haɗa bayanan da aka tura da mutanen da suka gina su. Muna amfani da shi ne kawai don shiga kundin da sabunta bitarsa.

Account.title: Abubuwan da na tura
Account.intro: Bi kowanne bayani daga turawa zuwa bitarsa.
Account.empty: Ba ka tura manhaja ba tukuna.
Account.emptyText: Ka san wata manhaja mai amfani daga Arewa? Tura ta domin dubawa.
Account.websiteNote: Adireshin shafi yana nan yadda yake yayin da ake duba bayani.
Account.updated: An sabunta bayanin da ake dubawa.
Account.editIntro: Sabunta mahimman bayanai yayin da ake ci gaba da bitar wannan bayani.

Admin.title: Jerin dubawa
Admin.intro: Duba abubuwan da aka tura da kulawar da aka yi wajen ƙirƙira su.
Admin.reasonPlaceholder: Ba mai ginawa dalili mai amfani kuma takamaimai.
Admin.notAllowed: Ba ka da izinin duba abubuwan da aka tura.

NotFound.title: Wannan shafi ya canza ko babu shi.
NotFound.text: Wataƙila samfurin ko shafin bai zama na jama’a ba tukuna. Kundin manhajoji wuri ne mai kyau don ci gaba.

Footer.title: Arewa Is Building
Footer.text: Wuri mai tsari don abubuwan dijital da aka yi a Arewacin Najeriya da na 'yan Arewa a ko'ina.
Footer.builtWithCare: An yi da kulawa domin Arewa.
